ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $P$ is a point inside the equilateral triangle $ABC$. When $\triangle ABP$ is rotated $60^\circ$ clockwise around point $B$, it becomes $\triangle CBP'$. If $PB = 3$, what is the length of $PP'$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} We have, since rotating $\triangle ABP$ $60^\circ$ clockwise about point B yields $\triangle CBP'$,\\
thus $\angle PBP'=60^\circ$ and $BP=BP'$,\\
therefore, $\triangle BPP'$ is an equilateral triangle,\\
hence $PP'=BP=\boxed{3}$
